lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with higher spot density observed in the median longitudinal row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like configuration; spots are frequently positioned at the intersections of these horizontal and vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity dorsal edges to low-intensity ventral shadows.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated on the anterior half of the fin surface, with roughly 6-8 distinct spots visible despite surface water distortion.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-luminance spot patterning is visible across the entire surface of the pectoral fin; multiple low-luminance oblong silhouettes (commensal teleosts) are clustered around the ventral and pectoral regions.
